title: fix(app-shell): Studio opens no buffer over a dashboard draft the server refuses to read
body:

_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbBQ4XUR5tGZokvWQhsUpFrY)_

Fixes #29015

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

The two lines are copied from the claim (comment 6571613254) and its amendment (comment 6571673304).

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：Studio 读草稿时，服务器因受众门（`requiredPermissions`）回 403 的草稿，不再被当成"没有草稿"。Interfaces 里这个项不再打开已发布版本供编辑，改为显示一条拒绝说明，自动保存因此没有可发送的内容。
- 为什么改：之前作者打开一个自己无权读取的仪表盘草稿时，Studio 显示已发布版本，下一次自动保存把它当草稿无前置条件写回，草稿丢掉权限门和其他未发布改动，发布后仪表盘对所有人可见（18.3.0 挡版项）。
- 风险与回滚：只影响草稿读取返回 403 的项；无草稿、可读草稿、其他读取失败的路径不变。回滚即撤销本 PR。
- 先看：`StudioDesignSurface.tsx` 叶子加载处新增的 `'refused' in draftRead` 分支；`DraftConflictDialog.tsx` 的 `readDraftForSave` 与 `isDraftReadRefused`；新测试 `StudioDesignSurface.draftUnreadable-29015.test.tsx`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.draftUnreadable-29015.test.tsx`，预期 2 个用例通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `readDraftForSave` (`metadata-admin/DraftConflictDialog.tsx`) keeps its answer and pin for every outcome, and now also hands a draft read refused `403` back as `refused`. `isDraftReadRefused` tells that refusal apart by status. A `403` on the draft read means the row is there and withheld (the read gate's audience refusal, `PERMISSION_DENIED`, by design), so it is no absence. Any other failure is handled exactly as before: no answer, no pin, no `refused`.
- The Interfaces pillar's leaf load (`StudioDesignSurface.tsx`) installs no buffer when the draft read carries `refused`. It does not read the published layer to stand in for the draft, so the canvas and inspector show nothing to edit and `useDraftAutoSave` has nothing to send. The refusal strip says the item has an unpublished draft this author may not read, that editing the published version would overwrite it, and that someone who holds the draft's required permissions can edit or publish it. The server's sentence is behind Details.
- One new Studio string, `engine.studio.refusal.draftUnreadable`, in the studio namespace tables (`en`, `zh`).
- `packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts` is unchanged: the server's `403` is the designed answer, and the defect was the client reading it as "no draft".

## Tests

- New `StudioDesignSurface.draftUnreadable-29015.test.tsx`, over a server double whose draft read refuses the gated dashboard draft the way the client throws it (`status: 403`, `code: PERMISSION_DENIED`):
  - the refused leaf shows the strip with the server sentence in it, renders no canvas and no edit control, never reads `/layers` for the leaf, and after the autosave window has sent no save; the stored draft still carries `requiredPermissions`;
  - control: with no pending draft the published body opens and an edit saves pinned `If-None-Match: *`.
- `DraftConflictDialog.test.tsx`: a `403` read returns `{ answer: null, pin: null, refused }`; a network failure carries no `refused`; `isDraftReadRefused` is false for a `500` and for `null`.
- Ablation (one-shot, through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, restored to HEAD's blob): with the new leaf-load branch disabled, the refused-leaf case goes red ("Unable to find an element with the text: This item has an unpublished draft…") and the control stays green.

## Acceptance notes

- The same reading of a `403` draft read as "no draft" sits in other `readDraftForSave` callers, which this PR does not change: the app navigation load in the same pillar (an app draft carrying `requiredPermissions` is refused the same way, and the nav save goes unpinned), and `ResourceEditPage`, `ObjectListViewInspector` (list views carry the same gate), `StudioBundleItemEditor`, `PermissionMatrixEditor` and `ObjectHooksPanel`. Each can now ask `refused`; reported to the seat as a family, not filed from here.
